lines.trans: Mr Chun Yuqiao, coming to keep our appointment does me a great honour.
How may I be of service?
Do you not mind the trouble I caused you last time?
Are you about to apologise, Miss Xin?
Does anyone need to apologise to a cad?
Even a cad has moments when he is wronged.
I, Xin Huimei, have always done things my own way, yet I never act muddle-headedly.

lines.trans: I heard the truth about your breakup from her.
Still, I want to hear it confirmed from your own lips.
If I was in the wrong, I will apologise.
There is no need to tell you my private affairs, and you will never get the truth from her.
Will you really not have a glass?
I do not drink alcohol.
